digest.en: Asia-Pacific leads the board this hour with Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition. Middle East & Africa carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.

articles.title: Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition
articles.summary: Min Aung Hlaing transitioned from commander-in-chief to president in Myanmar after tightly Five years after mounting a coup that ousted an elected civilian government, Min Aung Hlaing has overseen tightly staged elections transitioning him from commander-in-chief to president. articles.title: Issues of War and Peace Gain Top Billing in Armenia’s Election
articles.summary: Armenians will vote in a general election on 7 June. Armenians will head to the polls on 7 June for the country’s first general election since 2021. articles.title: I thought my daughter was learning spelling for school – but she was also learning gender
articles.summary: CNA Women senior editor Penelope Chan found her daughter's primary school spelling booklet She expected her daughter to learn new words in primary school.
